Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.controlcenter

Interface ControlPanel

All Known Implementing Classes:
AppearancePanel, BluetoothPanel, CustomizationPanel, DateTimePanel, DesktopPanel, DisplayPanel, FileAssociationsPanel, InputPanel, LocalePanel, NetworkPanel, NotificationsPanel, PowerPanel, PrintingPanel, QuickLaunchPanel, SchedulePanel, ServicesPanel, ShortcutsPanel, SoundPanel, StoragePanel, SystemInfoPanel, SystemUpdatePanel, TaskSchedulerPanel, UsersPanel, WorkspacesPanel
public interface ControlPanel
One category page of the control center. Implementations supply their own Swing component and are discovered through ControlPanelRegistry, so new categories can be added without touching the control center shell.
